title: Thoughts
paragraphs: "But you know... since I've lived in mixed-race Zeltoble for quite a while now, let me just say—from the perspective of Demi-Humans or humans, wouldn't that be pretty tough?"
"Well, I suppose so."

Just based on personality alone, he's the kind of person I can't stand. He looks half like a pig, after all. The shape of his nose is similar, too… Oops, that’s rude to elephants. Let me correct that.

“He’s the kind of person who’s never truly loved anyone from the bottom of his heart… I think he’d immediately switch partners if he found someone with a higher status or better income than his current one.”
“I’m sorry, but I agree.”

Éclair agreed with Yuki-chan’s words. It’s true that there are plenty of such people in this world. I’d always thought they were mostly found among the humans and Demi-Humans of Faubrey, but it seems there are some like that in Siltvelt as well.

“Speaking of which, it doesn’t seem like Lord Elmero has particularly high expectations for Lord Iwatani either. He’s likely serving him strictly as a knight. Though, to be honest, I can’t quite picture it…”
“It’s not that there aren’t potions or Magic to temporarily shrink your body, but the effects don’t last long, and there aren’t many who can cast them…”
“It’s not just about size, is it…?”
“Éclair, Father isn’t the type to judge people by their appearance! You’ll be just fine with him!”

After all, he’s Filo-tan’s father. He even got involved romantically with Big Sister’s older sister, and apparently had all sorts of things going on with a panda, too. He’s not the kind of vulgar person who cares about looks or anything like that!
“I’m really curious about the way Lord Kitamura phrased that… but I get the feeling it’s best not to delve into it here.”
“They say being the Shield Hero is no easy task, after all.”
“Come to think of it, Father mentioned before that the slow life with the Beastmen of Siltvelt looked like fun, didn’t he?”
I seem to recall him mentioning something about the ‘Such-and-Such Forest.’ I suppose there are plenty of forests out there—is there something specific in mind?
“I can understand the desire for a more leisurely life. We must ensure that Lord Iwatani finds peace through our protection, though…”
“Isn’t the reason I felt so strangely relaxed at my parents’ house because of that ‘slow life’ vibe?”
“Hmm… In that regard, Lord Lasa scores high points. Lord Iwatani seemed to be having a good time. Keep up the good work.”
“Listen… I’m not talking about me—I’m talking about Elmero. For example, if we did something similar in the new territory, wouldn’t that score high points too?”
“What are you all talking about?”
Father is approaching with an elephant carrying Kou on its back.
“Father with an elephant—”
“Ah, we’re talking about how he really went wild!”
“Mm-hmm!”
For some reason, we got interrupted by a panda and an Éclair.
“That’s right.”
And now even Yuki-chan has joined in. Are we not supposed to talk about how Father is falling in love with an elephant?
“Ah… yeah, you’re right. How should I put it… I feel like I’ve just caused nothing but trouble for the Puhant family, too.”
Father looks exhausted.
“Isn’t that fine? He came to our house as a reward for Elmero, yet he kept acting in a terribly rude manner. Since he insulted the Shield Hero, he can’t complain about being cast aside.”
“It’s true… I’ve come to realize all too well that I should have explained things better beforehand…”
Zou apologizes to Father in a quiet voice.

“It’s okay. I think it was something we couldn’t avoid anyway… In fact, I’d say it’s better that we dealt with it early. It would’ve been a bigger problem if he’d gradually interfered with Elmero until Elmero was completely exhausted and collapsed, and then someone else took his place.”
“Shield Hero…”
Zou replied to Father with a happy expression.
“Elmero’s going to do something, right?”
“Oh, that’s right. Then I’ll go get ready.”
“Okay.”

And with that, Zou walked into the mansion with Kou. Before long, Zou had finished getting ready to leave. Carrying a large bag, it seems he’d also spoken with his close servants and such. I could see the rat Beastmen heading out of the mansion.
“Who are they?”
“They are those who served Lady Rainy, my foster mother. Besides them, some of the slaves working at the mansion have asked to accompany us.”
“O-oh, I see.”
Father seemed slightly put off upon hearing the word “slaves.” After all, this is Siltvelt. Here, humans are generally considered to be of a lower status.
“Are we taking them to the castle?”
“They have preparations to make as well… It’s been decided that Meir will accompany us as their representative to handle the necessary formalities.”
Zou said that, then introduced the rat beastman who’d explained the situation to me to Father.

“We would like to express our deepest gratitude for the tremendous pardon granted to Lord Elmero and for resolving the matter concerning Lady Rainy. Shield Hero, we are deeply moved by your great generosity, and we intend to remain loyal to you until the end of our clan’s existence!”
“The mouse just gave you a kiss, Father.”
“Motoyasu-kun!”
Somehow, Father got mad at me. I guess that’s what you call saying one word too many. I thought it was a good joke, though.
“I would also like to express my gratitude to the Spear Hero on this occasion.”
Huh? I got swept up in the moment. The rat Beastman is thanking me, too.
“Yeah. I think things are going to get tough for Elmero from now on, so I’ll be asking for your help with various things.”
“I’ll be happy to oblige.”
“Well then, shall we head back to the castle?”
“Yes.”
“Well then, everyone of the Puhant family, excuse us. Goodbye.”

After Father received minimal medical attention, he returned to the castle without saying goodbye to the mammoths who had been carried away, but after bidding farewell to the mammoths who had stood by and watched without fighting.

After returning, it seems Father explained the general outline of what had happened at Zou’s family home to the leading figures of Siltvelt and discussed future plans. As a result, I hear that Zou’s family name has been changed and their fief has been determined. Of course, it seems they were granted the territory that belonged to Zou’s foster parent—whose name was Rainy—during his lifetime. So, since Father wanted to talk with Zou, he went over to Zou’s room to visit.
Meanwhile, Kou was chatting with Filolial-sama in the castle. Oh? I can hear Zou singing from somewhere in the castle.
“Oh, Elmero’s singing—let’s all sing along, Kou and everyone!”
“Yeah.”
Filolial-sama starts singing too. It’s quite a lively scene inside the castle.
“That settles it, then.”

“It’s a commotion that could be said to have been stirred up by Lord Kitamura… but I suppose worrying about it is a losing battle. Lord Elmero has now shaken off his doubts and secured a territory where his loved ones can live… I can’t afford to fall behind either.”
Éclair seems to be saying something. But we all know just how limited Éclair’s skills are when it comes to managing a territory, don’t we?
“Are you sure you’ll be all right, Éclair? I know you lack those kinds of skills.”
“Lord Kitamura… no, never mind. I suppose I’ll have to study up on a few things myself!”

It seems Éclair has set a goal for herself and is determined to do her best. Meanwhile, Panda has gone to visit Zou with Father. Incidentally, I hear Father had a long conversation with Zou and didn’t return to his room until late at night. He must have spent some sweet time with Zou and Panda. With that, the “Rival” flag is off.
And that’s how the events at Zou’s parents’ house came to an end.

It’s the evening after we visited Zou’s parents’ house. By the way, during our conversation after returning from Zou’s parents’ house, Rival didn’t really have any complaints. I don’t have any weaknesses, after all. That’s only natural.
“Hey, Gaelion, I’m thinking of heading back to my hometown for a bit.”
Rival suddenly said that during dinner.
“So, is the plan to visit Gaelion-chan’s house next?”

Father asked Rival with an air of “once bitten, twice shy.” Is there some significance to going to this guy’s parents’ place? …Come to think of it, I feel like I’ve only been to the cave where Rival’s parents live about once in each loop. Is there something going on?
“It’s not a house worth showing off, and you’ve already seen it. Besides, I think my older sister would give you the stink eye, so I don’t think you should come.”
“Well… I guess so. Is it okay to just go back home like I said before?”
“That’s the plan. I thought it might be a little early, but since I’ll be meeting with the Queen of Melromarc while I’m there to check things out, I figured it’d be fine.”
“Got it. When are we leaving?”
“I plan to head out right after dinner. Time is money.”
“That soon? Are you sure you don’t need to rest?”
Father seems worried about Rival for some reason, but this guy said it himself before: he makes his subordinates take on his fatigue. He’s an outrageously exploitative dragon.
“I’ll be fine! I’ll rest over there while I’m at it, so no problem.”
“Won’t they be startled by such a sudden visit…? Like, ‘A dragon invading our territory’ or something?”
At that, Rival snorts derisively.
“Dad’s nothing but a pushover compared to the current Gaelion. There’s absolutely no way I’d lose, even by a slim chance.”
“I’m not so sure about that, though…”
“Yeah. I totally agree—it’s clearly just her making fun of him.”
“Mm-hmm.”
“Y-yeah, you’re right.”

Panda, Éclair, and Elephant all agree with Father’s opinion. HAHAHA, this is exactly the kind of reputation a disloyal dragon who doesn’t respect their parents deserves. You have to cherish Father, just like I do, you know?
“Either way, it’ll be fine. You can send her off without worrying.”
“Gaelion-chan can be pretty pushy at times… Well, Sakura-chan will be happy if she goes to Melromarc, so I guess it’s okay.”
“Hmm? Can I see Mel-chan tomorrow?”
Sakura-chan, who had been quiet while Rival was talking, realizes she’ll get to see her Finacée and cheerfully asks Father.
“That’s right. How have you been lately, Sakura-chan? Are you having fun with Melty-chan?”

“Yeah. You know, at a party with Mel-chan… We sing and dance, you know? And sometimes we sneak out for secret outings and sing in front of the fountain or at places that serve drinks—everyone seems to be having a great time!”

Oh… It seems Sakura-chan has been promoting Filolial-sama in Melromarc alongside her Finacée. Apparently, their performances at evening parties and such have been well-received. Just like Filo-tan. I’m not exactly thrilled that her Finacée is taking on that role, but if it makes Sakura-chan popular, then it’s all good.

Ideally, I’d like to boost her popularity in Shieldfreeden, where it’s been a bit sluggish lately. I suppose I’ll have to consider entering Sakura-chan in races along the same lines as Yuki-chan. Well, as for me, my PR efforts at Shieldfreeden are starting to bear fruit.
Heh heh heh… Rival. My future Father is already on my side. While you’re leisurely visiting your hometown, Shieldfreeden will fall into our hands. Hahahahahaha!
“That’s great. Well, since we’ll see each other again tomorrow, maybe I’ll ask Sakura-chan and Melty-chan to put on a concert somewhere.”
“Got it!”
Sakura-chan nodded with a beaming smile. Oh, she truly lives up to being a Filo-tan, doesn’t she? What a divine smile!
“It’s great that Sakura and the others are singing, but it might be a good idea for Yuki and the others to join in as well, for the sake of goodwill.”
Lately, it seems Yuki-chan has been learning about public relations for Filolial-sama. She’s gradually started taking care of various things on her own, without me having to teach her.

By the way, among the Filolial-samas we received from the Great Filolial-sama, there were some who offered to help with management, as if to support Yuki-chan. Many of them take the form of adult Filolial-samas when they transform into angels. I hear that, thanks to this unprecedented lineup, they’ve managed to attract a new customer base.
So, after deciding on tomorrow’s plan, it’s time for dinner.
“Well then, Naofumi, see you later!”
Rival had used Father’s portal skill to head to Melromarc a step ahead of us. We decided to just go straight to bed. Heh heh heh, Rival isn’t around… It’s a good night.
“Since Gaelion isn’t here, maybe I’ll stay over at Mel-chan’s place? What should I do?”
Sakura-chan said this while thinking about Rival, who had returned home. Hmm? I feel like an option that hasn’t crossed my mind in a long time just popped up.
Let Sakura-chan go to her Finacée’s place. → Don’t let Sakura-chan go to her Finacée’s place.
This isn’t even a discussion. The answer is “Don’t let Sakura-chan go to her Finacée’s place”! With this, the happy ending is just around the corner—five seconds away!
